resourceList.description: Map of resource name (e.g. cpu, memory) to Kubernetes resource quantity.

claims.description: Dynamic resource claims (Kubernetes 1.26+) used by the container.

listOrEmptyObject.description: A list of objects. An empty object ({}) is accepted for backwards compatibility with the chart defaults.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the Ingress.

host.description: Hostname to route through the Ingress.

tls.description: TLS configuration for the Ingress (secrets and hostnames).

global.description: Global values shared with parent and sibling charts.

replicaCount.description: Number of replicas. Ignored when autoscaling is enabled.

image.description: Container image configuration for Element Web.

repository.description: Container image repository for Element Web.

tag.description: Image tag. Defaults to the chart appVersion when empty.

defaultServer.description: Default homeserver, rendered into default_server_config of config.json.

url.description: Base URL of the default homeserver (m.homeserver.base_url).

name.description: Server name of the default homeserver (m.homeserver.server_name).

identity_url.description: Base URL of the identity server (m.identity_server.base_url). Defaults to https://vector.im.

config.description: Additional Element config.json settings, merged with default_server_config. See https://github.com/element-hq/element-web/blob/develop/docs/config.md

env.description: Environment variables for the container. Currently not rendered; ELEMENT_WEB_PORT is fixed to 8080 in the Deployment.

extraVolumes.description: Additional volumes to add to the Pod.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Additional volumeMounts to add to the Element Web container.

imagePullSecrets.description: imagePullSecrets to use for pulling images (e.g. [{name: my-secret}]).

nameOverride.description: String to partially override chart name.

fullnameOverride.description: String to fully override chart fullname.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the ServiceAccount.

name.description: Name of the ServiceAccount to use. If not set and create is true, a name is generated using the fullname template.

podAnnotations.description: Annotations to add to the Pod metadata.

securityContext.description: Container-level security context (capabilities, runAs*, readOnlyRootFilesystem, etc.).

port.description: Service port for the Element Web UI.

ingress.description: Ingress for the Element Web UI.

resources.description: CPU/Memory resource requests/limits for the Element Web container.

tolerations.description: Tolerations for taints to schedule on matching nodes.

enabled.description: Create a NetworkPolicy for the Element Web Pod.
